cases.prompt:
Fix the accessibility of this form. Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files. ```html
Send
Error: invalid ```
criteria: Replaces the clickable div with a real button element
Adds a visible label linked to the input (placeholder is not a label)
Adds appropriate alt text (or empty alt if decorative) to the image
Flags the low-contrast error text and links the error to the field (e.g. aria-describedby)
Does not add redundant or wrong ARIA where native HTML suffices

cases.prompt: Our landing loads a 4 MB hero PNG, 1.2 MB of JS including all of lodash and moment, and fetches the same /api/config three times on load. What should we fix first? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Prioritizes by user-visible impact (hero image / LCP first or clearly ranked)
Recommends modern image formats, sizing and dimensions for the hero
Recommends removing or replacing heavy dependencies (lodash/moment) or importing only what is used
Recommends deduplicating the repeated /api/config request
Mentions measuring before and after

cases.prompt: To be accessible, should I add role="button" aria-label="button" tabindex="0" to every <button> and aria-hidden to all icons? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Says native <button> already has the role and focusability, so these attributes are redundant
Warns that aria-label='button' would harm screen reader output
Explains aria-hidden only for decorative icons, not meaningful ones
Recommends native semantics first

cases.prompt: I have a modal dialog in React that opens with a button. Users complain they cannot close it with the Escape key or tab through its elements without focusing background content. How do I fix this? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Recommends trapping focus within the modal while open
Recommends handling the Escape key to close the dialog
Recommends restoring focus to the trigger button upon closing
Recommends appropriate dialog role and accessible name (aria-labelledby or title)

cases.prompt: How can I optimize this PostgreSQL query that joins 5 million order rows with a customers table? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Suggests checking EXPLAIN ANALYZE execution plan
Recommends index on foreign keys or join columns
Discusses connection pooling or query restructuring

cases.prompt: What emotions do blue and green typically evoke in branding for an eco-friendly travel company? Answer in chat only; do not modify or create files.
criteria: Associates blue with trust, calm or reliability
